source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Linux still displays the down icon for ascending tree sort, while macOS and Windows use the up icon. Windows contrast styling uses SelectedItem and SelectedItemText and a thicker current-row outline. Its current @media block no longer has the original :root:not([lwtheme]) qualifier. Prefer that accepted scope when reviewing a new change. Preserve intentional platform behavior rather than assuming identical selectors or arrows. No platform UI or forced-colors measurement was performed. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Check platform tree rules before consolidating styles
